veranderings.voor: Sy sê haar praatjie gaan oor bloed, en ons sal later van ander maniere leer
veranderings.na: Suster Nomsa sê haar praatjie gaan oor bloed, en ons leer later van ander maniere
veranderings.rede: 'Sy' directly follows 'Lerato vra toe', so a Grade 4 reader can take Lerato as the speaker; naming the nurse fixes the reference, and dropping 'sal' (future still carried by 'later') keeps the word count unchanged.
